title: Corpus2Skill: Distilling Enterprise Knowledge into Navigable Agent Skills for QA and RAG
abstract: arXiv:2604.14572v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM responses in external evidence but treats the model as a passive consumer of search results, with no view of how the corpus is organized or what it has not yet seen. We present Corpus2Skill, a system-level retrieval architecture for bounded, structurally coherent corpora such as enterprise knowledge bases: an offline compiler distills the corpus into a hierarchical skill directory, and at serve time an LLM agent navigates it, drilling from a bird's-eye view through progressively finer summaries down to documents and backtracking when a branch is unproductive. On an enterprise customer-support benchmark, Corpus2Skill improves both answer quality and grounding over single-shot dense, hybrid, hierarchical-retrieval, and agentic RAG baselines at a moderate cost tradeoff, and the lead persists under encoder-matched controls and paired significance tests. translated_title: Corpus2Skill：将企业知识提炼为可导航的代理技能，用于问答与检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 摘要：检索增强生成（RAG）将大型语言模型的响应基于外部证据，但将模型视为搜索结果的被动消费者，无法了解语料库的组织方式或尚未覆盖的内容。我们提出Corpus2Skill，一种针对有界、结构连贯的语料库（如企业知识库）的系统级检索架构：一个离线编译器将语料库提炼为层次化的技能目录，在服务时，一个大型语言模型代理对其进行导航，从鸟瞰视角通过逐渐精细的摘要深入至文档，并在分支无成效时进行回溯。在企业客户支持基准测试中，Corpus2Skill在答案质量和依据性方面均优于单次稠密检索、混合检索、层次检索和代理式RAG基线，且成本权衡适中，该优势在编码器匹配控制和配对显著性检验下持续存在。一项涵盖11个数据集的研究表明...
tldr: Corpus2Skill通过离线编译企业知识库为层次化技能目录，并让LLM代理在线导航该目录，显著提升了检索增强生成在问答和依据性上的表现，优于多种基线方法。
en_tdlr: Corpus2Skill distills enterprise knowledge bases into a hierarchical skill directory that an LLM agent navigates at serve time, improving QA and grounding performance over various RAG baselines.
